annotations.text:
Flow: Board (kanban + New from idea) -> live progress -> approve the publish -> diff review -> Push & open PR.
SimpleMode is the same ticket, non-developer view — deliberately no sidebar.

ApprovalPrompt = the HIGH-risk treatment only (publish gate; always an OS notification, mandatory reject reason, no Undo, no auto-allow).
MEDIUM is the compact inline card and LOW the passive line — both in TicketDetail's stream. The cumulative-risk strip in TicketDetail's rail promotes the next MEDIUM to HIGH.
TicketDetail: use the "Needs you" switch to see #94 (in flight, click the stepper for phases), #108 pipenzo:awaiting-stack-approval, #113 pipenzo:needs-pre-scoping, #85 ci-failed.

Board: Working shows bounded concurrency (2 of 2 running, a held card with the file overlap, an approved stack as a container card). Both diff-gate outcomes land in Needs human. ci-failed sits in Ready for review because the fix re-enters the push gate.
